youtube.title: Toothpaste ke tube pe wo chhota square kya batata hai? 🪥 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapne toothpaste tube ke end pe wo chhota rangeen square dekha hoga. Internet kehta hai ki ye andar ka content batata hai, lekin ye bilkul galat hai.

Tube machine pe bharte hain, ek minute mein sau se zyada. Light sensor us square ko pehchanta hai, taaki machine ko pata chale ki seal kahan karna hai. Ye bas machine ki aankh ka nishana hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
